editorial: You’ll be whisked into a whirlwind of up‑beat holiday mischief as two Christmas elves scramble, turning Santa’s high‑stakes mission into a slapstick nightmare in this family‑friendly holiday comedy. What sets Prep & Landing: The Snowball Protocol apart is its blend of crisp CGI contrasts and hand‑drawn magical details that feel both fresh and nostalgically retro. The highlight is Wayne’s frantic mishap montage—each frame a jittery celebration of holiday chaos, punctuated by a surprisingly moving choir of reindeer. It’s perfect for families craving bright, festive laughs without the grind of adult drama.
targetAudience: Ideal for families looking for bright, festive laughs without the grind of adult drama.
